six_views.task_interaction: goal -> critical inputs together -> explicit template/version/field scope -> adopt -> check/render -> run -> direct delivery or <=3 repairs -> editable handoff; cancel/back preserves draft
six_views.structure_data: canonical FactoryGenerationGoal/ParameterSource/TemplateSubset/ScenarioInput/GenerationContext; exact field_bindings below; no second inventory
six_views.state_behavior: workflow_transitions below; Host Task lifecycle separate from generation decision; short atomic edit and frozen long task inputs
six_views.interface_collaboration: same 18 Commands, typed params/results, device capability mapping, Host identity injected; public gaps in handoff_ref
six_views.UI_presentation: same project workbench, bottom tools, menu-controlled 160px timeline and separate description dock; scope preview/forms consume field bindings; no frontend created
six_views.deployment_validation: actual existing rmcp3.5.1 native stdio/current-session Windows pipe fixture and read-only DuplicateHandle subprocess trials completed; 40-case authorization model; product Host/renderer/Codex/UI/human remain unexecuted

field_bindings.consumer: ScenarioInput demand/check/report; name-only stays in local incomplete form

field_bindings.source: user goal plus declared content conversion
field_bindings.encoding: DecimalAmount {coefficient:SafeUint,decimal_places:DecimalPlaces}; integer target -> coefficient=Q,decimal_places=0; exact decimal parsing, not a plain JSON number
field_bindings.unit_resolution: paper carton seed has ItemType carton with unit piece; carton count is display semantics; compare selected product plus registered UnitId, not unit label alone; bundle conversion uses actual content relation once

field_bindings.consumer: resource calendar and sizing; no assumed 24h
run_scenario/get_run/compare/report; same-timestamp end closure from Engine
layout bounds/check/render; Hall requires resolved values

field_bindings.source: declared actual/template dimensions and allowed layout mode

field_bindings.consumer: SetDeclaredParameter; RFC6901 relative to definition; no arbitrary path

field_bindings.type: opaque stable IDs and declared versions
field_bindings.source: selected exact definition and current Host revision
field_bindings.consumer: adopt/check/render/run/save; freeze does not implicitly adopt
one atomic InstantiateTemplate; no active Run stock copying

input_resolution.incomplete_form: UI/private form draft until required FactoryGenerationGoal fields exist; no malformed check call
input_resolution.ordinary_examples: explicitly labeled editable template values; do not present as measured data
input_resolution.missing: save draft and missing_conditions; supported complete sub-scope may run with declared scope only
input_resolution.template_selection: Bundled/ProjectPackages/UserGrantedLibraries only; category + industry + family + site applicability + real capability. Within authorized choices prefer complete applicable exact-version template, then fewer unresolved inputs, stable id/version ordering; show chosen reason. A change outside authorized product/template/field scope requires user decision, ordinary tie does not force a new approval.

layout_and_sizing.modes: selected profile's actually supplied straight_line/u_shape/parallel_lines; anchor coordinates and declared extents
layout_and_sizing.algorithm: instantiate declared transforms, rotate true footprints/clearance envelope, check Hall bounds/height/obstacles/non-overlap; a gap yields objects/Issue; do not resize geometry to fit
layout_and_sizing.initial_bound: ceil(Q*t_i/(H_i*b_i)), only positive resolved effective time and output converted to accepted unit
layout_and_sizing.bound_meaning: optimistic no-loss necessary count, never throughput proof; resources/supply/setup/transfer/quality handled by real Engine
layout_and_sizing.objective: feasible declared template and modeled accepted goal; no unbounded layout/schedule search or extra professional kernel

repair_contract.effective_change: compare typed before/after on granted meaningful fields; title-only or identical values do not justify a capacity rerun
repair_contract.round_consumption: one committed repair batch consumes one round even if subsequent check fails; preview/no-op consumes zero and stops if no alternative supported change
repair_contract.loop: read actual shortfall/waits -> supported/granted proposal -> no-op stop or atomic commit -> fresh check -> real run when runnable -> read result/compare -> decide; immutable previous Runs
repair_contract.comparison: same base supply, time reference, window, unit, acceptance and scope; actual granted input differences listed; incomparable runs explicitly flagged
repair_contract.round_counter: private generation-session counter increments only on confirmed actual repair EditCommit; failed subsequent check consumes that committed round. Do not infer from revised_run_ids count. On ambiguous lost admission stop automation, preserve last confirmed count/proposal.

workflow_transitions.effect: one missing list; preserve draft; no target pass

workflow_transitions.event: necessary checks Pass and matching real render

workflow_transitions.effect: object/field problem; runnable sub-scope explicit, no whole-goal claim
initial_target_met; one Run, no required compare
actual waits and granted changed fields only
commit and consume one repair round
cancel_task -> real terminal; completion wins if already committed
restore layout only, no undo of Run/approval/files

operation_chain.effect: read real implemented capabilities, granted scope, exact objects/version and inputs
TaskHandle -> get_task.TaskOutput.Import -> explicit AdoptImportedDraft; only when actual package import needed
CreateDefinitionDraft/PutDefinition/SetDeclaredParameter/AdoptModule/InstantiateTemplate/PutObject typed batch; revision and field grant
TaskHandle -> get_task.TaskOutput.Render; matching requested_scope_revision and actual visible objects
TaskHandle -> get_task.TaskOutput.Run -> get_run; ProjectScenario or explicit DefinitionCycle, same Engine
at least two real runs only when repair exists; typed MetricScope/acceptance; actual comparability
explicit selected purpose and frozen revision -> TaskHandle -> actual typed files; no publish

mcp_host.bridge: Rust/rmcp3.5.1 native exe; no HTTP/TCP listener
mcp_host.client: user's current Codex first; installed CLI 0.162.0-alpha.17.2 read-only checked, no Super Factory connection tested
mcp_host.stdio: initialize/initialized negotiation -> tools/list actual schemas -> tools/call; one JSON-RPC line per message, stdout protocol only
mcp_host.IPC: current-logon SID explicit DACL/remote reject; IpcHello.expected_host_instance_id -> IpcWelcome.client_session_id; IpcRequestFrame -> IpcResponseFrame originating_operation
mcp_host.framing: IPC u32 LE byte length then exact UTF-8; 1048576 bytes; MCP stdio uses newlines, not IPC length prefix

versions.MCP: negotiated SDK/client supported version; pinned 2025-11-25 document reference is not a universal support claim

mcp_host.caller: HostCallContext and ResolvedCallScope injected by real Host; API body contains no caller identity/approval/file path authority
mcp_host.field_scope: canonical HostCallContext.edit_grants and 15 private branches merged/native compiled by window1; current grant candidate-diff/creation-ledger enforcement modeled in 40 independent cases; real Host execution absent
mcp_host.disconnection: revoke connection grant; accepted tasks remain Host-owned; no automatic ambiguous mutation retry or new Engine
mcp_host.MCP_tasks_extension: not required or registered by this design; business TaskId/get_task/cancel_task are ordinary tools

task_result_contract.admission: seven long operations return actual TaskHandle; no held edit lock during CPU/render/IO
task_result_contract.progress: actual phase/processed/known total; unknown total not a guessed percentage
task_result_contract.cancel: cancel_task action=cancel -> CancellationState.action_accepted/terminal_won/task; read actual terminal, not cancel_requested success
task_result_contract.controls: pause_calculation/resume_calculation/step_next_timestamp only in actual allowed_controls; step is next complete same-time closure, no material reconsumption
task_result_contract.partial: Cancelled/partial Run known range retained; whole_window_computed=false never whole-goal PASS
task_result_contract.files: completed typed output and actual root/file commit only; frozen saved R vs current R+1 remains dirty

timeline_consumer.definition_ref: docs/02_交互设计/时间轴主轴与子轴完整定义.json
timeline_consumer.path: get_run Summary -> Events explicit interval/page -> FullResult or managed result -> ObjectsAt at_ms<=computed_until_ms
timeline_consumer.identity: one run_id + RunInputRef + confirmed relative ms; Job/Phase/Claim/Wait IDs and event sequence; old Run never rebound to current draft
timeline_consumer.waiting: canonical JobState.execution_ref; WaitInterval.execution_ref/phase_ref/reasons; RunResult.phase_work_intervals and computed_until_ms, same actual Run/input. Public records merged; absent real history remains unknown.
timeline_consumer.partial_data: not-yet-computed or not-all-pages labeled; final_items is not arbitrary historical stock; unknown phase not nominal reconstruction
timeline_consumer.editing: only input handles -> PutObject ScenarioInput, base_revision and granted leaf changes; actual bars read-only
timeline_consumer.UI: bottom tools; Window menu (窗口菜单) controls default 160px timeline dock and separate readonly description dock; latest batch instruction overrides older View-menu wording; original UI owners synchronize their source
timeline_consumer.Events: point events include observer end: start_ms<=at_ms<=end_ms; duration intervals remain half-open; stable paging/scoping even interval=null

delivery_permissions.report: one frozen EvaluationReport including generation_context, actual run_refs, input assumptions, scope, missing_conditions and unit definitions
delivery_permissions.initial_success: one real run_ref, revised_run_ids=[], scenario_comparison=null allowed
delivery_permissions.files: Host-issued SelectedFileRef.selection_id/purpose; grant expires on close/switch; no arbitrary path
delivery_permissions.rights: Host-confirmed selected asset rights only; imported declaration does not authorize redistribution
delivery_permissions.approval: RecordArtifactAcknowledgment UI-only; Agent adopt_artifact requires existing matching acceptance_ref
delivery_permissions.errors: same 10 public error families and RFC6901 field_errors; normal shortfall/Fail/Undetermined is business result; no alternate tool to bypass
